formal_baseline.duration_definition: Sum of two separate AISBench spans. Each starts before the earliest client POST and ends at the latest timestamp for a nonempty, non-comment, non-[DONE] SSE chunk, before JSON parsing; excludes seed warmup, between-round time, and full HTTP completion.
formal_baseline.draft_counter_scope: Differences of service-level Prometheus snapshots across two engines, not individual request accounting or independently timed draft performance. Position interpretation depends on historical source semantics and aligned snapshots.

q_scatter_rope_aggregate.scope: 1920 selected rank/run/layer windows from one profiled capture; histograms are separate marginal distributions, not request or tensor linkage
limits: No rank, timestamps, prompts, token values, tensor identities or events are included.
These derived histograms permit independent arithmetic verification, not independent reproduction of the profiler capture or proof of causality.
Two histograms are separate marginal distributions and do not permit pairwise linkage.

dynamic_quant_crossshape_pairs.scope: 32 same-rank/layer pairs from two distinct profiled batch digests, EP0-7 and layers 0/12/24/36; unique same-name task with matching shape except first dimension and matching dtype/format; actual effective work, inputs and operator identity unbound
dynamic_quant_crossshape_pairs.limits: Profiler samples from different batches; cannot infer online throughput, fixed overhead, causal bottleneck, same effective work, tensor identity or speedup.

mc2_gate_l14_l39.scope: 8 EPs in a single profiled batch, same-rank two layers; selected gate and MC2 tasks unique, same stream and nonoverlapping; per-type signatures match; no input identity or effective workload binding
mc2_gate_l14_l39.limits: Different layers and weights, actual routed workload and profiler distortion unknown; no causal inference or unprofiled timing.

ffn_crossshape_four_tasks.scope: 32 same-EP/layer scope pairs, different batch digests and physical row count 595 versus 1023; four same-stream nonoverlapping selected task shapes, dtypes, format and name normalized by row; actual tensor connections unknown
ffn_crossshape_four_tasks.limits: Different profiled batches and uncertain effective work; medians may refer to different pairs; no claim of shared expert identity, fixed overhead, online speed or benefit.

selected_layer36_five_task_pairs.scope: One profiled scheduler digest, L36 on two selected ranks; each selected task has matching exported shape, dtype, format, core and block count; actual effective work, data and cross-device timing unbound
selected_layer36_five_task_pairs.limits: Only one pair of scopes; not independent online experiments or a causal comparison.

q_two_projection_shapes.scope: one profiled EP3/L36 host-scope with two host-to-flow task links; same exported shape inputs do not prove identical tensor or full dense work
q_two_projection_shapes.limits: Conditional standard dense work accounting; 9.1 shape contract and history 9.2 runtime parameters, valid rows, binarity and actual arithmetic not proven.

f32_selected_projection_rows.scope: eight selected shape-compatible independent host-flow-device scope records in one scheduler digest; only one EP has separately associated host call and communicator metadata
f32_selected_projection_rows.limits: Matching selected digest and row counts do not prove same request, tensor identity, valid tokens, padding or group membership across ranks.

client_first_data_comparison.timing_scope: Baseline before JSON parsing, diagnostic after JSON parsing; diagnostic adds profiler and synchronous logging hook and uses a different client/process.
client_first_data_comparison.limits: Prompt-list fingerprint matched saved workload and diagnostic outputs matched reference, but request-to-device identity, warm-cache state and full request equality are not proven; differences cannot be assigned to profiler, network, NPU or any stage.

same_stream_l14_l39_matched.selection: One scheduler digest, eight devices, two selected layers and one stream per device; signature unique in each layer on every device. Exported shape, dtype, format, type, core and block settings match within each pair.
same_stream_l14_l39_matched.limits: Selection excludes other streams, unmatched tasks and MC2 internals. Equal exported signature does not imply equal effective work or input; profiler distortion and causality unknown.

limits: Baseline is an observation of a fixed workload, not a hardware limit.
Profiled task intervals are not unprofiled or end-to-end latency.
Profiler coverage and source/binary/tensor identity are incomplete.
Raw traces and inputs are not included; arithmetic checks do not reproduce the original measurements.

target_mainstream_sample_percent.scope: 16 ranks per sample, selected 40 target layers; not end-to-end or matched requests

moe_ledger.limitations: Specified direct dense shapes and example payloads; actual precision, counts, reuse and traffic require binding. Nominal capacity is not a certified hard peak.

limitations: Profiler samples are not no-profiler baseline timings.
Projection samples are separate workloads and physical rows may include padding.
Candidate fusion and reordering are not validated speedup or exhaustive coverage.
No real MoE count was captured by synthetic dump probes.
